title: TradeStation i TradingView ogłaszają integrację API
主要内容: TradeStation Securities, Inc., a subsidiary of Monex Group and a multiple award-winning online broker and futures commission merchant, will be integrated into the TradingView terminal within the next few months. Existing TradingView users will be able to place orders and benefit from TradeStation's reliable order execution. The integration is planned to be completed in the third quarter of 2019. Additionally, new accounts opened in TradeStation and funded by July 31, 2019 (including those opened by TradingView customers), will enjoy commission-free trading until the end of the calendar year.
